notes.content:
Those characters I evolved from older ideas, well, as I already said on previous posts, my idea as a gamedev was always do a beat'em up, and I've tried some times by doing Unity Ingame animation, like, divide a character in parts to do rotation inside unity and well... the results wasnt good at all, looks a lot like scribblenauts, not that the animation on scribblenauts wasnt work, but for a beat'em up dont work as I like, so I will post here some evolution of my ingame art.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/9f55484eeb47bf6a85b21c12c36307f0915dcf57.png[/img]
This character was kinda "kobold" from old medieval ideas, well everyone that I evolved comes from a medieval idea, was kinda Guardian heroes style, but the ghost hunting idea was so cool that I bring the game to somenthing new and changed everyone, lets continue:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/075a09fc98dca7ff93185bf194a32719ebe5db28.png[/img]
those was kobolds too, I make a spiritual animal on ghost puncher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/7008682f9436b2b53f004ec0da93b20d468c259f.png[/img]
The skeleton dont changed cause they are just ghost always
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/57d724feef0fab6bbf6fb2a842ea228ad1f5cab1.png[/img]

Well, thats it for a while, I will bring more evolution of my characters for ghost puncher on future posts, bb guys, thx a lot for the wishlists!

notes.title: Discord Server and a little bit about fusions.
notes.content:
Hi guys, I'm bringing some news here, about opening a discord server. Well, I've been thinking a lot about it, and I'm opening it before the game launch because I want to have some inputs when I let the Demo playable.

https://discord.gg/GwjDyMVv That's the discord server, I don't have any admin or somenthing, but I'm trying to learn about it, btw that's it, that's another channel to talk to me.

Aw, I want to talk here about fusions. Some characters are going to fuse like in lf2, but this is going to change a little bit the mechanic of it. When you have both the characters and already opened the fusion on story mode, if both players with pre-fusion characters hold the punch button, or kick (I'm going to test it first) and run against each other, one of 2 players is going to get the fusion result, a better character, a cooler mechanic for story mode, vs mode and any mode, but one of the players is going to stop playing, but is going to do somenthing on story mode and, after some time, the fusion just stops and the characters goes back to normal.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/5617f0dd6ebec1e238652fa42b0b4f0f15b051f7.png[/img]
Those are going to have 2 fusions, by the story, and on vs mode and there will be different buttons hold to fuse for one of them, the bad or the good version of fusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/b78b43be01e11c111075e9c0e1e7270594a53587.png[/img]
This one is a particular case, that is kind of a special mode. This character is inspired by Randy from Guardian Heroes, a character that is followed by an animal that fights along him, so when he uses a particular power when he's weak, he transforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/c0efa7699e1bda67805265b734503cf41912144d.png[/img]
Those are inspired in Freeze and Firen and Firzen from lf2, they're from rival clans, but in story mode they need to get together to fight somenthing big. I'm doing it as an Easter Egg of lf2, I'm a huge fan of it.

notes.title: Launch data and my first devlog here!
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Gege, the gamedeveloper of this huge project called Ghost Puncher. 

This is the game of my dreams. I have worked on it by myself by years. My favorite game of all times is Guardian Heroes, that I've played with a great friend called Caio by all my teen era (hehehe) and another big inspiration is Little Fighers 2 (the first multiplayer on the same keyboard that I've played) by its creativity and fun gameplay. 

Ghost puncher is basically why I've started learning game development in 2012. I remember doing games in which I could learn some stuff about beat'em up, like a sidescroller to learn about colision and damage, and a small concept that looks a lot like Zelda 2 to make some small battle system, and none of them was a good game, but they were a path to bring me here ːsteamhappyː. I've started with stencyl, a 2D engine, to learn about programming logic, and then I moved to Unity and got a lot of freelances, so I could still learn about gamedev and coding, and kept doing my small games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/c1230afa98b71f2b8ad50fdee127211a19771ac2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/c45441e3ab48a535d7a0c8f15604708ea36764eb.png[/img]
My first game here on steam was Monsters Mall. It was kind of a leap of faith to learn how to do a game and try to sell it on steam. That was pretty huge in my head: the first sellings and some mixed reviews made me think about what I was doing, and someday I will go back and upgrade that game, but by now I'm planning to build a huge game, with Story Mode and 'food system' (for stamina in battle), training system to upgrade you character, sleep and even with sidequests and dungeons (like those in persona, that is a hospital or a huge abandoned building).

One thing that I'd like to do is to bring that "mechanic" from Guardian Heroes, which is: EVERY character in game is playable (I think that just the plants in GH weren't cause they don't walk) and even citizens were playable, I think this kind of mechanic is AMAZING!) And there's another reference  with smaller impact that is Hot Blood for Snes, that the player can attack some pedestrians on street, and sometimes they just engage in fight, that was so awesome! Well, im putting my soul on this game. It will start by 0.1 with 9 characters and a simple park background, but I want to bring a lot of places, and a lot of monsters to be playable and to be enemies in story mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41904094/e04760bfe8d7b6c77b4675b3372c2594b29a6686.png[/img]
I will develop some ideas that I have in mind to bring those mechanics to a lot of characters.
This first 0.1 will bring 9 characters, but when I first launch the story mode this will change. I want the player to have a book with the cards of all enemies,  every one of them that you defeat at story mode will bring to other modes and even to a story mode+, so the players can try to beat the game with ANY character of this game, even the weaker one (maybe a citizen, maybe a small ghost).

Well, this is the game of my LIFE, so the idea is to work on it for years. I want to bring fusion (lf2 style) of some characters, some transformations (kinda Super Sonic/Dragon Ball style), cool bosses with diferent styles that transform too.

The only part that I have been helped right now is the music of this game, that has been made by a great friend of mine since school time, called Celso. He will keep doing the music kinda Linkin Park, Limp Bizkit and those references style. My work will be everything else, code, concept art, ingame art, etc...

Already finishing the first version of game. It will come with versus mode with some characters, not too much done but already a start to feel the game, other options will come on menu with explanation of gameplay styles. 

I hope you guys like it, this is the game of my life.
